blocks.zh: Section 1 Introduction 導論
blocks.en: Section 1 Introduction

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 區分 Reprocessing（再加工）與 Reworking（返工）的定義，並說明兩者對生物製劑 CQA 的影響差異。
blocks.en: Distinguish the definitions of Reprocessing and Reworking, and explain how each differs in its impact on biological CQAs.

blocks.zh: 理解在何種條件下可考慮採用這兩種工具，以及為何必須優先釐清根本原因（Root Cause）。
blocks.en: Understand the conditions under which these two tools may be considered, and why the root cause must be clarified first.

blocks.zh: 掌握「主動策略（Proactive Approach）」與「被動策略（Reactive Approach）」在法規申報路徑上的本質差異。
blocks.en: Grasp the essential difference between the "Proactive Approach" and the "Reactive Approach" in the regulatory filing pathway.

blocks.zh: 了解 TR 74 (2026 修訂版) 的適用範圍擴展，以及臨床製造階段額外謹慎的理由。
blocks.en: Understand the expanded scope of TR 74 (2026 revision) and the reasons for extra caution during clinical manufacturing.

blocks.zh: 1.0 Introduction 導論
blocks.en: 1.0 Introduction

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Key Concepts
blocks.en: Key Concepts

blocks.zh: Reprocessing（再加工）：製程步驟在已驗證操作範圍之外運行後，重新執行同一個步驟（回到上一步，在可接受範圍內重跑）。步驟本身不變，只是「再做一次」。
blocks.en: Reprocessing: repeating the same process step after it has been run outside its validated operating range (returning to the previous step and re-running it within acceptable ranges). The step itself does not change; it is simply "done again".

blocks.zh: Reworking（返工）：對產品施以一個或多個不在原始既定製程內的步驟，以獲得可接受的產品。這是一個「計畫外的新步驟」——風險遠高於 Reprocessing。
blocks.en: Reworking: applying one or more steps that are not part of the originally defined process in order to obtain acceptable product. This is a "new, unplanned step" and carries much higher risk than Reprocessing.

blocks.zh: 關鍵區別：Reprocessing = 重跑已知步驟；Reworking = 引入未驗證的新步驟。前者可被預先納入 Change Management Plan，後者幾乎不可能事先全面預測。
blocks.en: Key difference: Reprocessing = re-running a known step; Reworking = introducing an unvalidated new step. The former can be built into a Change Management Plan in advance; the latter can hardly ever be fully predicted beforehand.

blocks.zh: Potency（效價）：生物製劑的功能性生物活性指標。由於量測困難，Reworking 對 Potency 的影響往往無法被完整偵測——這是生物製劑返工限制的根本科學原因。
blocks.en: Potency: the indicator of a biological product's functional biological activity. Because it is difficult to measure, the effect of Reworking on Potency often cannot be fully detected. This is the fundamental scientific reason for the limits placed on reworking biologicals.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: Reprocessing = 重新過濾一鍋湯：你按既有食譜熬湯，因壓力偏高導致過濾不乾淨。你的處理方式是把湯倒回去，再用同一道濾布重過一次。步驟沒有改變，只是重做。這就是 Reprocessing。
blocks.en: Reprocessing = re-straining a pot of soup: you cook the soup by the established recipe, but high pressure leaves the straining incomplete. You pour the soup back and strain it again through the same cloth. The step has not changed; it is simply repeated. That is Reprocessing.

blocks.zh: Reworking = 廚師臨時加工序來「救菜」：但如果湯已因過熱而蛋白質部分變性，你必須增加一道原食譜沒有的「澄清步驟」來修復。這就是 Reworking——引入了食譜以外的操作，必須重新驗證是否對最終品質有影響。
blocks.en: Reworking = a chef improvising an extra step to "rescue" the dish: but if the soup has been overheated and some of the protein has denatured, you must add a "clarification step" that is not in the original recipe to repair it. That is Reworking: you have introduced an operation outside the recipe, and you must revalidate whether it affects final quality.

blocks.zh: 為何生物製劑更危險？生物製劑如同精緻的舒芙蕾（Soufflé）——一旦結構受到干擾，即便外觀恢復正常，內部結構（Tertiary structure、Glycosylation pattern）可能已悄然改變，而現有測試方法偵測不到。
blocks.en: Why are biologicals more at risk? A biological is like a delicate soufflé: once its structure is disturbed, even if it looks normal again, its internal structure (tertiary structure, glycosylation pattern) may have quietly changed, and current test methods cannot detect it.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes
blocks.en: Key Notes

blocks.zh: 決策優先序（Decision Hierarchy）：不論製程壓力有多大，任何 Reprocessing / Reworking 決策都必須遵循：
blocks.en: Decision Hierarchy: however great the process pressure, every Reprocessing / Reworking decision must follow this order:

blocks.zh: Sterility Assurance（無菌保證） — 不可妥協
blocks.en: Sterility Assurance - non-negotiable

blocks.zh: Product CQAs（關鍵品質屬性） — 患者安全第一
blocks.en: Product CQAs (critical quality attributes) - patient safety first

blocks.zh: Business & Flexibility（商業利益） — 最後考量
blocks.en: Business & Flexibility - considered last

blocks.zh: Root Cause 是前提，不是選項：TR 74 明確指出，接受 Reprocessing / Reworking 的必要先決條件是清楚的根本原因。沒有 Root Cause 就沒有資格進行任何補救措施——這是 GMP 的最低門檻。
blocks.en: Root cause is a prerequisite, not an option: TR 74 states clearly that a clear root cause is a necessary precondition for accepting Reprocessing / Reworking. Without a root cause there is no basis for any remedial action; this is the minimum GMP threshold.

blocks.zh: 2026 新增亮點：本版明確加入「Supply Chain Resilience（供應鏈韌性）」整合 FMEA 與供應風險評分的框架，是舊版（僅聚焦技術面）的重要升級。這也意味著未來稽核時，評估 Reprocessing 的文件必須涵蓋供應鏈風險的考量。
blocks.en: Key addition in 2026: this edition explicitly adds a "Supply Chain Resilience" framework that integrates FMEA with supply risk scoring, a significant upgrade over the previous edition (which focused only on technical aspects). It also means that in future audits, documentation evaluating Reprocessing must cover supply chain risk considerations.

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 假設你的 UF/DF 步驟因設備誤操作，流速超出驗證範圍。請判斷：這應走 Reprocessing 還是 Reworking 路徑？理由為何？
blocks.en: Suppose your UF/DF step runs at a flow rate outside the validated range because of equipment misoperation. Decide: should this follow the Reprocessing or the Reworking pathway? What is your reasoning?

blocks.zh: 為什麼 Potency 的量測限制，會讓生物製劑的 Reworking 比小分子藥物更複雜？請舉一具體例子說明。
blocks.en: Why do the limitations in measuring Potency make Reworking of biologicals more complex than for small-molecule drugs? Give a specific example.

blocks.zh: TR 74 提到「proactive approach」可在事前取得法規核准。請描述這種做法的核心文件是什麼，以及它必須涵蓋哪些內容？
blocks.en: TR 74 mentions that a "proactive approach" can obtain regulatory approval in advance. Describe the core document for this approach and what it must cover.

blocks.zh: 實務應用 Practical Application
blocks.en: Practical Application

blocks.zh: CDMO 場景：你公司正在為一個 Phase II 的 mAb 客戶進行臨床批次製造。Protein A 親和層析步驟因管線接頭鬆動，導致壓力偏差，收率低於預期下限。
blocks.en: CDMO scenario: your company is manufacturing a clinical batch for a Phase II mAb client. A loose line connector in the Protein A affinity chromatography step causes a pressure deviation, and yield falls below the expected lower limit.

blocks.zh: 你需要立即決策三件事：
blocks.en: You must make three decisions immediately:

blocks.zh: 是否符合 Reprocessing 的條件（Root Cause 是否明確？是否可重跑同一層析步驟？）
blocks.en: Does the event meet the conditions for Reprocessing (is the root cause clear? can the same chromatography step be re-run)?

blocks.zh: 客戶的 CMC 文件與 IND/IMPD 中是否預先納入了 Reprocessing 條款（Proactive approach）？若無，後續需要走哪種法規路徑？
blocks.en: Does the client's CMC dossier and IND/IMPD already include Reprocessing provisions (proactive approach)? If not, which regulatory pathway must follow?

blocks.zh: 供應鏈影響評估：此批次延誤對臨床試驗時程的衝擊，以及是否有備用庫存緩衝？
blocks.en: Supply chain impact assessment: the effect of this batch delay on the clinical trial timeline, and whether backup inventory is available as a buffer.

blocks.zh: 這三點的評估與決策文件，正是 TR 74 Section 1.0 所描述的完整管理框架的落地形式。
blocks.en: The assessment and decision documentation for these three points is exactly how the complete management framework described in TR 74 Section 1.0 is put into practice.

blocks.zh: 1.1 Purpose 目的
blocks.en: 1.1 Purpose

blocks.zh: TR 74 的定位：這份技術報告不是強制性法規標準（Mandatory Standard），而是「單一彙整的指引文件（Single-source overview）」，補充現有指引。其核心是整合 Scientific、Regulatory 與 Business 三者的平衡視角。
blocks.en: Positioning of TR 74: this technical report is not a mandatory standard but a "single-source overview" that supplements existing guidance. Its core is to integrate a balanced view across scientific, regulatory and business considerations.

blocks.zh: 涵蓋範疇（Lifecycle Coverage）：TR 74 從最上游的「設計（Design）」與「開發（Development）」開始，一路涵蓋到「法規申報（Regulatory Submission）」與「實施（Implementation）」。這意味著它適用於整個產品生命週期，不只是商業化後的緊急處置。
blocks.en: Lifecycle coverage: TR 74 starts from the earliest stages of design and development and runs through to regulatory submission and implementation. This means it applies across the whole product lifecycle, not only to emergency handling after commercialization.

blocks.zh: 三重平衡視角（Scientific × Regulatory × Business）：這是 TR 74 的方法論核心。任何 Reprocessing / Reworking 策略，都必須同時滿足這三個維度——單純的「科學可行」或「業務需要」不足以構成充分理由。
blocks.en: Triple-balance perspective (Scientific × Regulatory × Business): this is the methodological core of TR 74. Any Reprocessing / Reworking strategy must satisfy all three dimensions at once; being merely "scientifically feasible" or "needed by the business" is not sufficient justification.

blocks.zh: TR 74 如同「緊急應變手冊」：想像一本航空公司的飛行員異常程序手冊（Abnormal Procedures Checklist）。它不是強制飛行員按固定步驟執行，而是提供業界共識的最佳實踐路徑——飛行員（製造廠）仍需依情境判斷，但手冊確保沒有人從零開始摸索。
blocks.en: TR 74 as an "emergency response manual": think of an airline's Abnormal Procedures Checklist. It does not force pilots to follow fixed steps; it provides a best-practice path based on industry consensus. The pilot (the manufacturer) still has to judge the situation, but the manual ensures nobody starts from scratch.

blocks.zh: 「諮詢法規機關」的重要性：就如同重大改道前需要先通報 ATC（Air Traffic Control），在任何 Reprocessing / Reworking 策略實施前，與主管機關（FDA、EMA、TFDA）的事先溝通是降低批次拒絕風險的最有效手段。這不是法規義務的確認，而是風險管理的最佳實踐。
blocks.en: The importance of "consulting regulatory authorities": just as a major diversion requires notifying ATC (Air Traffic Control) first, early communication with the competent authority (FDA, EMA, TFDA) before implementing any Reprocessing / Reworking strategy is the most effective way to reduce the risk of batch rejection. This is not confirmation of a regulatory obligation but risk management best practice.

blocks.zh: 「高度建議諮詢法規機關」= 實質必要：雖然用詞是「highly recommended」而非「mandatory」，但在現實操作中，若在未與 FDA/EMA/TFDA 溝通的情況下擅自執行 Reworking，之後即便科學上有據，批次被拒絕的風險仍極高。臨床 CDMO 尤其如此——客戶的 IND 策略與你的製造策略必須一致。
blocks.en: "Highly recommended to consult regulatory authorities" = effectively necessary: although the wording is "highly recommended" rather than "mandatory", in practice, if Reworking is carried out without communicating with FDA/EMA/TFDA, the risk of batch rejection remains very high even if the science is sound. This is especially true for a clinical CDMO: the client's IND strategy and your manufacturing strategy must be aligned.

blocks.zh: CDMO 的特殊責任：作為 Contract Manufacturer，你的技術報告與 CAPA 記錄不只供自己使用——它們是客戶向法規機關提交 CMC 文件的重要支撐材料。TR 74 的框架提供了你與客戶溝通標準用語的基礎。
blocks.en: Special responsibility of a CDMO: as a contract manufacturer, your technical reports and CAPA records are not only for your own use; they are important supporting material for the client's CMC submissions to regulators. The TR 74 framework gives you a basis for standard terminology when communicating with the client.

blocks.zh: TR 74 強調「scientific, regulatory, and business considerations」的三重平衡。在實務中，若業務壓力要求儘快放行，但科學評估仍有疑慮，你應如何引用 TR 74 的框架來支持正確決策？
blocks.en: TR 74 stresses the triple balance of "scientific, regulatory, and business considerations". In practice, if business pressure demands quick release but the scientific assessment still raises doubts, how would you cite the TR 74 framework to support the right decision?

blocks.zh: TR 74 不是強制標準，但為何在稽核中引用它仍具有重要意義？請說明其在 GMP 合規框架中的定位。
blocks.en: TR 74 is not a mandatory standard, so why is it still important to cite it in an audit? Explain its position within the GMP compliance framework.

blocks.zh: 1.2 Scope 適用範圍
blocks.en: 1.2 Scope

blocks.zh: 範圍擴展的意義（2026 更新）：舊版 TR 74 只涵蓋重組蛋白（Recombinant Proteins）與多肽（Polypeptides）。2026 修訂版大幅擴展至所有生物製品，包括：
blocks.en: Significance of the expanded scope (2026 update): the previous TR 74 covered only recombinant proteins and polypeptides. The 2026 revision expands this substantially to all biological products, including:

blocks.zh: mAb（Monoclonal Antibodies）：包含 Innovator 與 Biosimilar
blocks.en: mAbs (Monoclonal Antibodies): both innovator products and biosimilars

blocks.zh: Vaccines（疫苗）
blocks.en: Vaccines

blocks.zh: Blood-derived Proteins（血液衍生蛋白）
blocks.en: Blood-derived Proteins

blocks.zh: 這對 CDMO 的意義：過去可能認為「我們不做疫苗，TR 74 與我無關」——現在這個理由不再成立。任何生物製品製造商都應將 TR 74 納入 QMS 參考文件體系。
blocks.en: What this means for a CDMO: you may once have thought "we do not make vaccines, so TR 74 is not relevant to us"; that reasoning no longer holds. Any biological product manufacturer should include TR 74 in its QMS reference document system.

blocks.zh: 「Process IS the Product」的核心概念：「The quality of biologicals is defined by the chosen production and manufacturing process.」這句話是生物製劑 CMC 的根基原則。生物製劑沒有固定的化學結構式——你的製程就是你的產品定義。這也是為何任何製程偏差（包括 Reprocessing / Reworking）都必須被嚴格評估對 CQA 的影響。
blocks.en: The core concept "Process IS the Product": "The quality of biologicals is defined by the chosen production and manufacturing process." This sentence is the foundational principle of biologicals CMC. A biological has no fixed chemical structural formula: your process is the definition of your product. This is why any process deviation (including Reprocessing / Reworking) must be rigorously assessed for its impact on CQAs.

blocks.zh: 「Process IS the Product」的直覺理解：小分子藥物如同工廠大量生產的標準螺絲——每顆規格相同，只要符合尺寸公差就可接受。生物製劑如同手工精釀啤酒——同一個配方，不同釀造師、不同溫度、不同攪拌方式，產出的風味結構截然不同。改動任何製程步驟，等於改動了「產品本身」。
blocks.en: An intuitive view of "Process IS the Product": a small-molecule drug is like a standard screw mass-produced in a factory: every unit has the same specification and is acceptable as long as it meets the dimensional tolerance. A biological is like a hand-crafted beer: with the same recipe, a different brewer, temperature or stirring method produces a completely different flavor profile. Changing any process step is changing "the product itself".

blocks.zh: 臨床 vs. 商業製造的差距：想像一位廚師（Manufacturer）在家練習新菜（臨床階段）——他對這道菜的每一個步驟還在摸索，對食材特性理解有限。此時若出了問題，他能做的調整空間更小，每次操作都是在累積知識、建立製程理解。商業階段則是這位廚師已在餐廳做了兩千份，非常熟悉每個變數——即便如此，生物製劑的返工仍需謹慎。
blocks.en: The gap between clinical and commercial manufacturing: picture a chef (the manufacturer) practicing a new dish at home (clinical stage). He is still feeling his way through every step and has limited understanding of the ingredients. If something goes wrong, he has even less room to adjust, and every operation builds knowledge and process understanding. At the commercial stage, the chef has already made two thousand portions in the restaurant and knows every variable well; even so, reworking a biological still demands caution.

blocks.zh: 臨床製造的雙重挑戰（針對我們的工作場景）：TR 74 明確點出，臨床階段的 Reprocessing / Reworking 比商業製造更困難，理由是：
blocks.en: The dual challenge of clinical manufacturing (for our own work setting): TR 74 states explicitly that Reprocessing / Reworking at the clinical stage is more difficult than in commercial manufacturing, for these reasons:

blocks.zh: 製程理解有限（Limited Process Understanding）：Design Space 尚未完整建立，製程邊界不清晰。
blocks.en: Limited Process Understanding: the Design Space has not been fully established and process boundaries are unclear.

blocks.zh: 產品知識不足（Limited Product Understanding）：CQA 清單可能尚未最終確定，比較性數據（Comparability Data）基準尚淺。
blocks.en: Limited Product Understanding: the CQA list may not yet be final, and the baseline of comparability data is still thin.

blocks.zh: 法規路徑不確定：臨床階段的 IND/IMPD 通常缺乏預先核准的 Reprocessing 條款，每次偏差都需要個案評估。
blocks.en: Uncertain regulatory pathway: clinical-stage IND/IMPDs usually lack pre-approved Reprocessing provisions, so every deviation needs a case-by-case assessment.

blocks.zh: 決策優先序在此處的應用：臨床試驗的時間壓力（招募中的患者在等待）是真實的業務壓力。但 TR 74 的立場清晰：即便在臨床階段，Sterility Assurance 與 CQA 完整性必須優先於試驗時程需求。
blocks.en: Applying the decision hierarchy here: the time pressure of a clinical trial (enrolled patients are waiting) is real business pressure. But the TR 74 position is clear: even at the clinical stage, Sterility Assurance and CQA integrity must take priority over trial timeline needs.

blocks.zh: 我們的位置（臨床期 CDMO）：TR 74 (2026) 第 1.2 節末尾這段話是直接寫給我們的：「clinical manufacturing is often more challenging than commercial manufacturing... extra caution is emphasized.」
blocks.en: Our position (a clinical-stage CDMO): the passage at the end of TR 74 (2026) Section 1.2 is written directly for us: "clinical manufacturing is often more challenging than commercial manufacturing... extra caution is emphasized."

blocks.zh: 這意味著什麼具體行動？
blocks.en: What specific actions does this imply?

blocks.zh: 在新客戶技術轉移（Tech Transfer）評估時，主動確認客戶的 CMC strategy 是否已預先處理 Reprocessing 場景（Proactive approach）。若無，建議列入 Risk Register。
blocks.en: When assessing a new client for Tech Transfer, proactively confirm whether the client's CMC strategy already addresses Reprocessing scenarios (proactive approach). If not, we recommend adding it to the Risk Register.

blocks.zh: 在 Process Characterization Study 設計時，考慮納入「邊界偏差情境（Excursion Scenarios）」的評估，為未來潛在的 Reprocessing 申請預鋪基礎。
blocks.en: When designing Process Characterization Studies, consider including an assessment of "Excursion Scenarios" to lay the groundwork for any future Reprocessing application.

blocks.zh: 與客戶協議 Quality Agreement 時，明確 Reprocessing / Reworking 的通報程序與決策授權層級——事前框架比事後爭議省時省力。
blocks.en: When agreeing the Quality Agreement with the client, define the notification procedure and decision authority levels for Reprocessing / Reworking; a framework agreed in advance saves time and effort compared with disputes after the fact.

blocks.zh: TR 74 (2026) 將範圍擴展到疫苗與血液衍生蛋白。請思考：這些產品與 mAb 相比，在 Reprocessing 上可能面臨哪些額外挑戰（提示：考慮原材料性質、製程複雜度）？
blocks.en: TR 74 (2026) extends its scope to vaccines and blood-derived proteins. Consider what additional Reprocessing challenges these products may face compared with mAbs (hint: consider the nature of raw materials and process complexity).

blocks.zh: 「The quality of biologicals is defined by the chosen production and manufacturing process.」請用一個你在工作中熟悉的製程步驟，說明這句話的具體含義——如果那個步驟出現偏差並需要 Reprocessing，你最擔心哪個 CQA 受到影響？
blocks.en: "The quality of biologicals is defined by the chosen production and manufacturing process." Using a process step you know well from your own work, explain what this sentence means in practice. If that step deviated and required Reprocessing, which CQA would you worry about most?

blocks.zh: TR 74 說明這份報告「不打算涵蓋所有類型的單元操作」。對於沒有被直接涵蓋的操作，你應如何運用 TR 74 的一般性原則進行類比評估？
blocks.en: TR 74 states that the report "does not intend to cover all types of unit operations". For operations not directly covered, how should you apply the general principles of TR 74 to assess them by analogy?

blocks.zh: Table 1-A: Reprocessing vs. Reworking — Key Distinctions 關鍵區別對照表
blocks.en: Table 1-A: Reprocessing vs. Reworking - Key Distinctions

blocks.zh: Dimension 維度
blocks.en: Dimension

blocks.zh: Reprocessing 再加工
blocks.en: Reprocessing

blocks.zh: Reworking 返工
blocks.en: Reworking

blocks.zh: Definition 定義
blocks.en: Definition

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: 定義核心：Reprocessing = 重跑同一步驟；Reworking = 引入計畫外新步驟。兩者都需明確 Root Cause，都需法規核准後才能放行。
blocks.en: Core definitions: Reprocessing = re-running the same step; Reworking = introducing a new, unplanned step. Both require a clear root cause, and both require regulatory approval before release.

blocks.zh: 生物製劑的限制根源：分子複雜性 + Potency 量測困難 = 無法完整偵測 Reworking 對 CQA 的影響，因此必須「謹慎進入」（enter with caution）。
blocks.en: Why biologicals are limited: molecular complexity + difficulty measuring Potency = the effect of Reworking on CQAs cannot be fully detected, so it must be entered "with caution".

blocks.zh: 主動 vs. 被動策略：Proactive approach（預先納入 Change Management Plan）是降低法規不確定性的最有效手段，但只適用於 Reprocessing；Reworking 幾乎無法完全預測。
blocks.en: Proactive vs. reactive approach: a proactive approach (building it into the Change Management Plan in advance) is the most effective way to reduce regulatory uncertainty, but it applies only to Reprocessing; Reworking can hardly ever be fully predicted.

blocks.zh: 2026 新增重點：範圍擴展至疫苗與血液衍生蛋白；加入供應鏈韌性（Supply Chain Resilience）與 FMEA 整合框架。
blocks.en: Key additions in 2026: scope extended to vaccines and blood-derived proteins; a framework integrating Supply Chain Resilience and FMEA has been added.

blocks.zh: 臨床 CDMO 的特殊挑戰：臨床階段製程理解有限 + 產品知識不足，使得 Reprocessing / Reworking 比商業製造更困難——TR 74 兩次強調「extra caution」，這正是我們工作環境的寫照。
blocks.en: Special challenges for a clinical-stage CDMO: limited process understanding + insufficient product knowledge make Reprocessing / Reworking more difficult than in commercial manufacturing. TR 74 stresses "extra caution" twice, which describes our working environment exactly.

blocks.zh: 決策優先序不變：Sterility Assurance > Product CQAs > Business & Flexibility。供應鏈壓力無論多大，都不能倒置這個順序。
blocks.en: The decision hierarchy is unchanged: Sterility Assurance > Product CQAs > Business & Flexibility. However great the supply chain pressure, this order must never be inverted.
